weeks.content:
Draw the classroom and the flag
Colour neatly

Fold and weave strips
Make a little mat

Paste cotton for clouds and sheep
Add a sun with paint

Thread big beads on a lace
Make a necklace or bracelet

Mould a small pot the local way
Smooth the sides with water

Paint a rainy day or a sunny day
Add umbrellas or clouds

Fold a paper boat
Fold a paper fan

Paint one big class picture
Everyone paints a part

Draw patterns from our culture
Look at adire and ankara patterns

Mount my best works
Present my favourite piece
